title: Findings marked for questioned costs
question: Which dated findings does the federal clearinghouse list for recipients reporting a San Francisco address?
finding: 119 distinct finding references across 64 reports in this selection. Rows link to individual audit reports; the 2021 MEDA filing uses a labeled mirror.
how: Join report and finding tables on the report ID. Group multiple award references by report ID and finding number. Normalize local spelling variants with 941 ZIP codes. For conflicting localities, require the same EIN, street and ZIP in a correctly located return or verify the auditee address in the original report. The original city and state are displayed. Preserve each auditor’s flags; when award rows differ, a flag appears if any row is affirmative.
limits: The November 7, 2026 bulk export identifies the reporting auditee’s address; awards can fund work elsewhere. A 941 ZIP on its own does not establish a San Francisco address. A questioned cost requires the grantor’s decision. The repeat and questioned tables overlap. Read the signed audit to determine the finding’s scope. For example, Eviction Defense Collaborative’s FY2023 record marks a material weakness. Its signed audit places 2023-001 under financial statement findings and reports no federal award findings or questioned costs for that year. The public data may predate later resolution.
